concerns.text: The 'Edge Cases' section is not linked to any functional requirement (FR) or success criterion (SC). Adding unanchored edge‑case handling expands scope beyond the original idea, which only required a working end‑to‑end pipeline.

The specification introduces variance‑inflation‑factor (VIF) reporting for descriptor collinearity, which was not requested in the idea and does not contribute to answering the research question. This constitutes an unnecessary over‑reach.
